title: Assistant Manager, Human Resources Business Partner
jobDescription: SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve. At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team! Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers within assigned business units throughout the employee lifecycle. Partner with assigned business unit leaders to understand team dynamics and provide HR guidance on employee relations, performance, and development. Support the implementation of HR policies and ensure compliance with internal procedures and legal regulations. Assist in the facilitation of performance management processes including goal setting, reviews, and talent assessments. Use tools like Culture Index and ActivTrak to monitor and enhance employee productivity and engagement for assigned business units. Generate and analyze reports in Workday to support decision-making related to compensation, roles, and workforce planning for assigned business units. Drive employee engagement initiatives through MTC, ERGs, and VoE programs for assigned business units Conduct exit interviews and analyze trends to provide actionable insights to assigned business unit leadership. Collaborate with HR Risk & Compliance to ensure adherence to employment laws and company policies. Provide guidance on performance management including coaching, career development, and disciplinary actions for assigned business unites Support HR operations including unemployment claims, benefits queries, job description updates, offboarding, and employment verifications for assigned business units. Assist in investigations related to employee complaints and recommend appropriate actions. Coordinate with employees on leave and attendance management for assigned business units. Lead or support special HR projects as assigned by HR leadership Other activities as may be assigned by your manager

title: Analyst, Identity Access Management Administrator
jobDescription: SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team! Job Functions supporting CyberArk: Identity & Access Management (IAM) Assist in managing AWS IAM users, groups, roles, and policies. Support role-based access control (RBAC) implementation and maintenance for AWS services, including EC2, Lambda, and other cloud resources. Provision, modify, and deprovision user access across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and infrastructure systems. Troubleshoot and resolve access-related issues, including permission errors, authentication failures, and role assumption problems. Participate in periodic user access reviews, certification campaigns, and entitlement audits. Identify, document, and escalate inappropriate access, policy violations, and segregation of duties concerns. Maintain accurate identity data, including user attributes, roles, group memberships, and entitlements across supported systems. Audit and maintain access controls to ensure compliance with organizational security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements. Privileged Access Management Assist in the administration and maintenance of CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions. Support onboarding and management of privileged accounts, service accounts, and application accounts within CyberArk. Assist with account discovery, password vaulting, credential rotation, and privileged session management activities. Monitor CyberArk platform health, password management processes, and scheduled jobs to ensure operational effectiveness. Troubleshoot and resolve CyberArk-related issues, including account onboarding failures, password reconciliation issues, and access request problems. Support privileged access request workflows, approvals, and access certifications in accordance with security policies. Assist in implementing and maintaining least-privilege and privileged access security controls. Perform periodic reviews of privileged accounts and privileged access assignments to ensure compliance with organizational standards. Generate and maintain CyberArk reports related to privileged account activity, password management, and compliance requirements. Maintain CyberArk operational documentation, procedures, and onboarding standards. Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams to onboard systems and accounts into CyberArk. Security & Compliance Assist in implementing and maintaining security controls related to identity and access management. Support vulnerability remediation efforts by deploying updates, patches, and corrective actions in response to identified security risks. Assist with audit requests and provide supporting documentation related to access management, privileged access management, and asset inventories. Ensure adherence to established security policies, procedures, standards, and best practices. Support compliance initiatives related to access governance, privileged access management, and information security controls. Service Management & Documentation Support ServiceNow workflows related to access requests, incident management, change management, and service fulfillment. Create and maintain documentation for IAM and PAM processes, workflows, system configurations, operational procedures, and incident resolutions. Maintain accurate records of system changes, troubleshooting activities, and access management actions. Develop and update knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures. Collaboration & Communication Collaborate with IT, Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Business teams to implement secure technology solutions. Provide technical guidance and support to team members and end users as needed. Communicate technical information effectively, both verbally and in writing, to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Plan, prioritize, and coordinate assigned tasks to meet operational objectives and project deadlines.
